mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the desire of the editor to maintain honesty and impartiality in the course of news gathering, processing and dissemination."
Editorial integrity is the desire of the editor to maintain honesty and impartiality in the course of news gathering, processing and dissemination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a planned and deliberate effort by the communicator to get his point of view patronized or accepted by his target audience."
Persuasion is a planned and deliberate effort by the communicator to get his point of view patronized or accepted by his target audience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the spinal cord of serious-minded newspapers."
An editorial is the spinal cord of serious-minded newspapers.

Editorial writing is an art, therefore it requires some good writing skills.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the aggregate of the views of members of the society on a given issue."

Classification is a process of putting something into the group or class it belongs to.

An editorial writer is a professional journalist who chronicles a journalistic essay or opinion expressing the corporate position of a newspaper or media establishment on a topical issue in the society.

Ethics are the general science of right and wrong.
